name: letter_case
description: Classify all-uppercase versus all-lowercase letter strings, with matched control copying the string.
generator_code:
import random,json,string
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 s=''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase,k=random.randint(3,7)));upper=bool(i%2);s=s.upper() if upper else s
 items.append({'prompt':f'The string "{s}" is written in uppercase or lowercase? Answer:', 'answer':' '+('uppercase' if upper else 'lowercase')})
 control.append({'prompt':f'The string "{s}" is copied without quotes here:', 'answer':' '+s})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
